findings.defect: Law allows Foundation reopen only for a measured evidence or test failure that exposes a foundation defect, real operation exposing a foundation defect not covered by current mechanisms, or an explicit Owner objective change. Blueprint section 14 instead allows reopen for an unresolved operational contradiction and for a security or continuity failure as separate triggers. Section 8.1 says a Blueprint conflict with higher law must be revised. It has not been.
findings.consequence: Freezing would lock two reopen standards. A later seat could reopen, or refuse to reopen, by choosing the list that is not the law's closed list.
findings.smallest_repair: Make Blueprint section 14 defer reopen triggers verbatim to the consolidated law list, or have Owner amend the law if the broader triggers are intended. Keep a single reopen list.
